name: bpc-customer-assessment-video
description: Reusable BPC NetSuite and NSPB customer assessment explainer

scripts.render:data-guide: node scripts/verify-assets.mjs data-guide && remotion render src/index.ts BPC-Client-Data-Preparation-Guide render/BPC-Client-Data-Preparation-Guide.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18 --audio-codec=aac
scripts.render:overview: node scripts/verify-assets.mjs overview && remotion render src/index.ts BPC-Customer-Assessment-Overview render/BPC-Customer-Assessment-Overview.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18 --audio-codec=aac
scripts.render: npm run render:data-guide && npm run render:overview
